subject: Electric Circuits
question: Two resistors of 4 ohm and 6 ohm are connected in series across an ideal 20 V DC source. What is the voltage across the 6 ohm resistor?
solution: The series resistance is 4 + 6 = 10 ohm, so the current is 20/10 = 2 A and it is the same through both resistors. Voltage across the 6 ohm resistor = 2 x 6 = 12 V. Shortcut (voltage divider): 20 x 6/10 = 12 V.
author: Rajon Das
